name: Rereminder
cover:
Does your timer
ring when it's
already too late?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
Ding.
Too late.
features.text:
The timer goes off mid-talk
and you haven't even started wrapping up.

features.label: Heads-up alerts
features.headline:
Hear it before
the end
features.text:
Get alerts 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes
before the end. Pick the ones you want.

features.label: A note on each
features.headline:
Every alert
says what to do
features.text:
"Wrap up the slides." "Take questions."
Add a message to each one.

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
See what's next
at a glance
features.text:
Split a talk into parts and see
the current note while the timer runs.

outro:
Finish on time,
not after the ding
